evidence.MCL: Linear hyperintensity signal of MCL on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 MCL injury and MCL bursitis.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: R/O meniscocapsular separation at the interface of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in anterior horn of lateral meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal
evidence.Contusion: Abnormal signal intensity is noted in femoral medial/ lateral condyle and tibial lateral condyle, which shows low signal intensity on T1WI and high signal intensity on T2WI, in favor of bone contusion.
evidence.Fracture: Irregular contour of inferior-lateral portion of right femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau, R/O subchondral fracture.
